notes: The nominated span is a Schedule of Compliance reporting duty: within 14 calendar days after the cyanide compliance date, the permittee must submit a written notice of compliance or noncompliance. Purpose A evaluates enforceable numeric discharge limits and whether reported measurements exceed them; this clause does not establish limits, monitoring frequencies, or compliance comparisons. Purpose B evaluates whether sampling/monitoring was required under permit conditions; this clause requires a one-time administrative notice, not monitoring or sampling. Purpose C evaluates semantics of missing numeric monitoring results (NODI, no-discharge, etc.); the notice obligation is unrelated to absent measurement data. Interpreting this passage would not change the computation for any declared purpose.
